name: Law Office of Chad Stavley
about: The Law Office of Chad Stavley works from Northwest 19th Avenue and describes a practice in significant injury and wrongful death, with more than a hundred trials and fifty million dollars recovered. Those are the firm's own figures and this directory has confirmed none of them, which is why no amount appears on this profile.
Contingency fees and a free consultation, published. Its Google listing averages a flat five stars across 94 reviews. It names no attorney on the pages we could reach.

json_ld_descriptions: Chad Stavley is Oregon's top-rated personal injury attorney, specializing in significant injury and wrongful death cases. Over 100 trials, $50M+ recovered for clients. No fee unless we win.

Chad Stavley is #1 Top Rated Portland personal injury lawyer who specializes in significant injury and wrongful death cases. He has tried more than 100 cases, including over 75 jury trials — considerably more than most lawyers try in their entire careers.
Chad Stavley is an Oregon personal injury attorney based in Portland. Licensed in Oregon and Washington, he has tried over 100 cases including 75+ jury trials and has recovered $50M+ for clients.
